supported_evidence: The 2021 architecture-specific case uses a 2 GW delivered plant.
supported_evidence_zh: 2021年特定架构案例采用2 GW交付容量。
limitations: The same number is used here as a study scale anchor, not as evidence that this architecture is preferred.
limitations_zh: 本项目把相同数值作为规模锚点，不代表该架构最优。

supported_evidence: The 2021 utility-scale economic case uses a 30-year operating life.
supported_evidence_zh: 2021年公用事业级经济案例采用30年寿命。
numeric_context: 30 years; the later small-scale study uses 15 years
limitations: Lifetime remains architecture-dependent and the model does not demonstrate survivability or refurbishment feasibility.
limitations_zh: 寿命取决于架构；本模型不证明生存性或翻新可行性。

supported_evidence: A lightweight modular concept reports substantial full-chain losses.
supported_evidence_zh: 轻量化模块概念报告了显著的全链路损耗。
limitations: Concept and subsystem boundaries differ; this does not directly set the model's 15% reference value.
limitations_zh: 概念与子系统边界不同，不能直接给出本模型15%参考值。

supported_evidence: The independent low/high products of listed efficiency factors bracket the study anchor.
supported_evidence_zh: 所列效率分量独立相乘后的低高范围覆盖本项目锚点。
limitations: The 15% reference is still a project assumption; multiplying independent extrema is not a probability distribution or validated integrated design.
limitations_zh: 15%仍是项目假设；独立极值相乘既不是概率分布，也不是已验证集成设计。

locator: Table 1, PDF pp.11-12; reference-design selection p.13
supported_evidence: The official small-scale study reports architecture-level total-efficiency cases around the model anchor.
supported_evidence_zh: 官方小规模研究给出围绕本项目锚点的架构级总效率案例。
numeric_context: 11.7-19.9%; selected Space Solar small-scale reference design 14.9%
limitations: The report states that major values are manufacturer-claimed, not independently verified; missing values are inferred and definitions may differ.
limitations_zh: 原报告说明主要数值来自厂商声称、未经独立验证；缺失值含推断且定义可能不同。

parameter_or_claim_zh: 交付容量因子代理变量
supported_evidence: The official study demonstrates that utilization varies materially by orbit and by the measured boundary.
supported_evidence_zh: 官方研究显示，利用率会随轨道和统计边界显著变化。
numeric_context: HEO: UK rectenna 95.7%, satellite average 53.9%; circular LEO: satellite average 20.1%, UK rectenna 21.5%
numeric_context_zh: HEO：英国整流天线95.7%、卫星平均53.9%；圆形LEO：卫星平均20.1%、英国整流天线21.5%
limitations: Rectenna utilization is not equivalent to this model's delivered capacity factor; the 90% value remains a study assumption.
limitations_zh: 整流天线利用率不等同于本模型交付容量因子；90%仍是研究假设。

supported_evidence: Lightweight structures are central to proposed modular SBSP architectures.
supported_evidence_zh: 轻量化结构是模块化空间太阳能架构的核心。
limitations: Areal density cannot be converted to whole-system kg/kW-space without power density and complete subsystem boundaries.
limitations_zh: 缺少功率密度和完整子系统边界时，面密度不能换算为整套系统kg/kW-空间端。

locator: Table 1, PDF pp.11-12; reference-design selection p.13
supported_evidence: The small-scale study identifies architecture specific power as an important performance variable.
supported_evidence_zh: 小规模研究把架构比功率列为重要性能变量。
numeric_context: 0.15-0.67 kW/kg; selected Space Solar small-scale reference design 0.58 kW/kg
numeric_context_zh: 0.15–0.67 kW/kg；所选Space Solar小规模参考设计0.58 kW/kg
limitations: Values are architecture-specific and partly manufacturer-claimed; inverse conversion is not imported as the model's whole-system specific mass.
limitations_zh: 数值取决于架构且部分来自厂商声称；其倒数不被导入为本模型整套系统比质量。

supported_evidence: The 2021 input review uses a broad architecture-specific spacelift range.
supported_evidence_zh: 2021年输入审查采用宽范围的特定架构航天运输成本。
limitations: Orbit, procurement, price year and service boundary differ from the model-defined staging-orbit variable.
limitations_zh: 轨道、采购、价格年份和服务边界均不同于本模型的中转轨道变量。

supported_evidence: Launch cost is a dominant driver in the official small-scale cases.
supported_evidence_zh: 发射成本是官方小规模案例的主导驱动因素。
limitations: Destination orbit, scenario year, vehicle, procurement and service boundary differ; although both are stated in 2024 GBP, the model's £500/kg reference is not taken from this table.
limitations_zh: 目的轨道、情景年份、运载器、采购和服务边界不同；尽管两者均以2024年英镑表述，本模型£500/kg参考值并非取自该表。

supported_evidence: NASA's favourable combined case includes a low launch-price assumption.
supported_evidence_zh: NASA有利组合案例包含低发射价格假设。
limitations: FY2022 USD, US procurement and architecture boundaries differ; no currency conversion or direct input transfer is made.
limitations_zh: 采用FY2022美元及美国采购/架构边界；本项目不做汇率换算或直接移植。

parameter_or_claim_zh: 实际项目贴现率代理变量
supported_evidence: Published SBSP cases use real pre-tax hurdle rates that decline with assumed maturity and investor class.
supported_evidence_zh: 公开空间太阳能案例采用随成熟度和投资者类别下降的实际税前门槛收益率。
limitations: Hurdle rate is not identical to WACC; this model's 6.5% real discount proxy remains study-authored.
limitations_zh: 门槛收益率不等同于WACC；本模型6.5%实际贴现率代理仍是研究假设。

parameter_or_claim_zh: 实际项目贴现率代理变量
supported_evidence: A 6.5% hurdle-rate input appears for selected mature terrestrial generators.
supported_evidence_zh: 部分成熟地面发电技术采用6.5%门槛收益率输入。
numeric_context: 6.5% for large solar and onshore wind
numeric_context_zh: 大型光伏和陆上风电为6.5%
limitations: This is not an observed SBSP WACC and does not specify this model's tax or financing structure.
limitations_zh: 这不是实测空间太阳能WACC，也不定义本模型税务或融资结构。

supported_evidence: The small-scale study provides a direct grid-infrastructure allowance per MW.
supported_evidence_zh: 小规模研究给出按MW计的并网基础设施预留。
limitations: The model uses £100/kW as its own simplified allowance; scope and site conditions may differ.
limitations_zh: 本模型自定£100/kW简化预留；范围和场址条件可能不同。

supported_evidence: Annex B uses a triangular O&M factor derived from terrestrial generation technologies.
supported_evidence_zh: Annex B采用由地面发电技术推导的三角分布运维系数。
numeric_context_zh: 三角分布下限/众数/上限为0.8%/1.9%/4.7%
limitations: Definitions and cost bases vary; the model's 1% of CAPEX per year remains a study assumption.
limitations_zh: 定义与成本基数不同；本模型每年1% CAPEX仍是研究假设。

supported_evidence: The project anchor lies inside one published early small-scale band.
supported_evidence_zh: 本项目锚点落在一个公开的早期小规模区间内。
limitations: This is not validation: scale, architecture, orbit, scenario year, financing and accounting boundaries differ.
limitations_zh: 这不是验证：规模、架构、轨道、情景年份、融资和会计边界均不同。

locator: Executive summary p.3; assumptions pp.18-19; Figure 5 p.22 and Table 4 p.23
supported_evidence: The earlier UK architecture study reports a much lower future case.
supported_evidence_zh: 较早英国架构研究报告了明显更低的未来案例。
numeric_context: £35-79/MWh (p10-p90), p50 about £50/MWh, 2018 prices; 2 GW; 30 years; 20% hurdle
numeric_context_zh: 2018年价格下p10–p90为£35–79/MWh、p50约£50/MWh；2 GW；30年；20%门槛收益率
limitations: Architecture, learning, commissioning year, financing and price basis differ; values are not ranked as like-for-like forecasts.
limitations_zh: 架构、学习、投产年份、融资和价格口径不同；不能按同口径预测直接排序。

supported_evidence: NASA's selected baseline and favourable-combination cases differ in lifecycle cost by roughly a factor of 20.
supported_evidence_zh: NASA所选基线与有利组合案例的生命周期成本相差约20倍。
numeric_context: FY2022 USD: $610/$1,590 per MWh baseline; $30/$80 per MWh favourable combination
limitations: US architectures, service profiles, currency and lifecycle boundary differ; no NASA value is imported into this model.
limitations_zh: 美国架构、服务曲线、币种和生命周期边界不同；NASA数值不导入本模型。

supported_evidence: The official small-scale study attributes most of its LCOE variance to launch assumptions.
supported_evidence_zh: 官方小规模研究把大部分LCOE方差归因于发射假设。
limitations: This project may rank specific mass first within its own one-way ranges; neither ranking is universal.
limitations_zh: 本项目在自身一维范围内可能把比质量排第一；两种排名都不是普遍规律。

supported_evidence: The official system cases reduce each reported LCOE by the same system-benefit adjustment.
supported_evidence_zh: 官方系统案例对每个公开LCOE采用相同系统收益调整。
numeric_context: adjusting for system benefits reduces LCOE by £21/MWh in all cases
numeric_context_zh: 计入系统收益后，所有案例LCOE均降低£21/MWh
limitations: The present model does not monetize whole-system value; £21/MWh is not subtracted from project LCOE.
limitations_zh: 本模型不把全系统价值货币化，也不从项目LCOE中扣除£21/MWh。

supported_evidence: Enhanced LCOE illustrates that wider system impacts can alter technology comparisons.
supported_evidence_zh: 增强LCOE说明更广泛系统影响会改变技术比较。
limitations: 2018 real GBP and scenario-specific; indicative only and not directly harmonised with the model's 2024 real GBP basis.
limitations_zh: 采用2018年实际英镑且依赖情景；仅作指示，未与本模型2024年实际英镑直接统一。
